thread:
Maya (new-hire): hi all — first week here, hitting weird networking issues. I ssh to bastion-us-east and after a few minutes my terminal freezes and git pushes fail with timeout. Using an M1 Mac, WireGuard split-tunnel profile provided by IT. Anyone seen this?

Leo (infra): welcome! Could be a few things: client-side keepalive, WireGuard DNS leaking, or short-lived NAT from your home router. Quick checks: do you have a ~/.ssh/config entry for the host? also paste WireGuard AllowedIPs and DNS if you can (no secrets).

Maya (new-hire): here's the host block I'm using:

```
Host bastion-us-east
  HostName bastion.us-east-1.redwood
  User maya
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p jump.redwood
```

Sanjay (it-support): @Maya thanks — our split-tunnel profile only routes internal subnets (10.0.0.0/8) and DNS to the cluster. On macOS, a common gotcha: the system DNS can flip to ISP resolver when WiFi decides to prefer a different interface, causing intermittent failures. Try setting the WireGuard DNS to 10.0.4.2 and enable "Set DNS" on the wg mac client.

Leo (infra): also add ServerAliveInterval 20 to your ssh config and consider ProxyJump instead of ProxyCommand. Example:

```
Host bastion-us-east
  HostName bastion.us-east-1.redwood
  User maya
  ProxyJump jump.redwood
  ServerAliveInterval 20
  ServerAliveCountMax 3
```

Maya (new-hire): ran that, left a ping running to 10.0.0.1 while I repro'd. Still saw a freeze once.

deploy-bot: rolling restart: bastion-us-east-2 will reboot for kernel patch in 5 minutes (maint-2026-04-04-7). Sessions on that host may drop.

Oncall Ops: confirm — we kicked a rolling reboot. If you landed on bastion-us-east-2 that would explain the terminate. Try `ssh bastion-us-east -J jump.redwood` to reach other hosts while we complete restarts.

Maya (new-hire): ah ok that explains one hang. But I also saw git fetch DNS errors right after the reboot: `fatal: unable to access 'https://gitlab.redwood/..': Could not resolve host`.

Sanjay (it-support): that message = DNS wasn't routed to internal resolver. Two options: 1) add `nameserver 10.0.4.2` to the WireGuard DNS setting, or 2) on mac, create a /etc/resolver/redwood file pointing to 10.0.4.2 for *.redwood. We'll push an updated WG profile that pins DNS for new hires.

Maya (new-hire): adding the internal nameserver fixed the git error. After switching ProxyJump and ServerAliveInterval I haven't seen disconnects for 30+ mins. Thanks!

Leo (infra): glad it's stable. We'll add a short snippet to the onboarding doc: "M1 macs + split-tunnel WG: set internal DNS and enable ssh ServerAlive*; prefer ProxyJump." Ping me if it crops up again and we can pair.

Sanjay (it-support): added checklist entry and created a ticket to update the WireGuard profiles for new hires to include DNS and AllowedIPs covering our gitlab subnet.

Maya (new-hire): awesome — appreciate the quick help and the warm welcome :smile:
